title: Bacterial toxin produced by E coli leading suspect in rise in bowel cancer among under-50s
summary_full: Scientists tell Commons committee that exposure to colibactin in early life is a potential driver of early onset colorectal cancerExposure to a bacterial toxin in early life has emerged as a leading suspect in the rise of bowel cancer among those under 50, MPs have heard.Cases of early onset bowel cancer have doubled in many countries in the past two decades, and while rising obesity and a fall in physical activity are contributors, researchers believe other factors must also be involved.
